headline: Keurig unveils plastic-free Alta coffee pod machine
summary: Keurig's new single-serve machine uses plastic- and aluminum-free coffee pods, called AltaRounds, instead of traditional K-Cups. The design was first shown two years ago. One outlet notes the pods are compostable; another says the price is steep.

claims.statement: Keurig introduced a new single-serve machine that uses plastic-free coffee pods instead of the K-Cup.
The new pod, called AltaRounds, was first shown off two years ago.
